alternate_mechanisms.label: C/B
alternate_mechanisms.title: The caravan is a living metabolic system
mechanical_discovery_refs: ر ب ب B014 ↔ ط ع م B006

ر ح ل B011 ↔ ط ع م B007
ع ب د B007 ↔ ط ع م B007

alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: Seasonal ecology supplies pasture and animal resources; feeding maintains bodily strength; strong mounts bear saddles and sustain movement; movement sustains exchange and human provision. Hunger therefore threatens the animal-powered transport body as well as the human body.
alternate_mechanisms.what_it_adds: It reveals an embodied feedback loop between food and travel: journeys obtain provision, but provision also powers the journeys.
alternate_mechanisms.caution: The loop is materially plausible and mechanically dense, yet the animal-body branches remain secondary.

alternate_mechanisms.title: The annual cycle can echo a generational household cycle

alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: Winter and summer provide the explicit annual recurrence. Birth, caregiving, milk, household storage, marriage, and successive formation provide a latent generational recurrence. Provision secures not only the next meal or next journey but the community's continuation through households.
alternate_mechanisms.what_it_adds: It expands continuity from repeated commerce to the reproduction and care of the people who undertake it.
alternate_mechanisms.caution: This is a coherent cluster but remains remote; no birth or marriage claim should be placed into the surface translation.

alternate_mechanisms.label: C/B
alternate_mechanisms.title: The passage contrasts protected obligation with coercive ownership
mechanical_discovery_refs: ع ب د B001 ↔ ر ب ب B011
ر ب ب B011 ↔ ء م ن B001
ر ح ل B009 ↔ ع ب د B004
ع ب د B004 ↔ خ و ف B002
alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: Covenants and safe-conduct create obligations that protect persons and exchange. Enslavement and subjugation create obligations through ownership, harm, and fear. Worship is positioned with the first system's divine benefactor, not with the second system's human coercion.
alternate_mechanisms.what_it_adds: It makes the ethical quality of lordship central: true lordship feeds and secures rather than producing hunger and fear.
alternate_mechanisms.caution: The legal contrast is secondary and should not collapse worship into a political theory of contract.

alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: Nightly food and overnight preservation secure the shortest interval; seasonal journeys secure the annual interval; household birth and successive formation secure the generational interval. Continuity is therefore produced at nested temporal scales.
alternate_mechanisms.what_it_adds: It explains how a brief four-verse passage can move from immediate hunger to a durable communal order without changing topics.
alternate_mechanisms.caution: The generational tier is C-level; the nightly and seasonal tiers are more strongly grounded.

alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: A secure journey requires more than the absence of attackers: it needs an intended route, avoidance of deviation, timely preparation, night strategy, known waystations, and reliable destinations. Familiar recurrence transforms uncertainty into orientation.
alternate_mechanisms.what_it_adds: It reads أمن as logistical predictability as well as emotional calm and political protection.
alternate_mechanisms.caution: The missed-timing and night-planning branches are exploratory and should remain subordinate to direct safety.

alternate_mechanisms.label: C/B
alternate_mechanisms.title: Hunger and fear converge in the vulnerable body

alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: Hunger empties and thins the body; fear can diminish possessions, become visible in physiology, and culminate in violent restraint of breath. Feeding and securing repair two distinct threats that meet in bodily vulnerability.
alternate_mechanisms.what_it_adds: It gives the final parallel clauses a shared embodied depth without treating hunger and fear as synonyms.
alternate_mechanisms.caution: The choking and leanness images are latent extensions, not explicit scenes.

alternate_mechanisms.label: C
alternate_mechanisms.title: Material nourishment can become moral discernment
mechanical_discovery_refs: ع ب د B003 ↔ ء م ن B002
alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: The passage names material nourishment and immediately demands worship. The latent value/discernment branch of طعم permits a cautious transition: receiving food should produce recognition of worth, trusting assent, and worship rather than proud refusal.
alternate_mechanisms.what_it_adds: It explains the rhetorical conversion from bodily benefit to moral response as an act of discernment, not as an arbitrary command shift.
alternate_mechanisms.caution: The value/discernment branch lacks a direct agent-queue bridge and remains exploratory.

alternate_mechanisms.label: C
alternate_mechanisms.title: Containers mediate movement, storage, and survival

alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: Saddles, patterned travel textiles, leather pouches, gathered contents, treated vessels, and overnight storage form a remote material-culture cluster. The journey system depends on objects that carry bodies, goods, liquids, and preserved food across distance and time.
alternate_mechanisms.what_it_adds: It makes continuity materially portable: īlāf is sustained not only by ideas and agreements but by crafted things.
alternate_mechanisms.caution: This is the most materially specific and lexically remote mechanism; preserve it at C only.
